documents.doc-cz-msp-2026-08-27-msp-19-2026-odka-r: On 27 August 2026, under ref. MSP-19/2026-ODKA-ROZ/26 in case 18 A 23/2026, the Ministry of Justice submitted its statement on the intervention action and related case material. The Ministry argues that the claimant lacks standing and that no intervention within the meaning of Section 82 of the Code of Administrative Justice occurred; it proposes dismissal of the action as inadmissible and, alternatively, rejection on the merits. This is the defendant authority's litigation position, not a court determination of the merits.
documents.doc-cz-ms-pha-2026-09-23-18-a-17-2026-18: On 23 September 2026, under ref. 18 A 17/2026-182, the Prague Municipal Court stated that it had received the claimant's motion to set a time limit for a procedural act. Independently of the motion dated 21 September 2026, the Court said it had planned and still planned to decide case 18 A 17/2026 in the coming weeks, within the thirty-day framework referred to in Section 174a(3) of Act No. 6/2002. It therefore was not at that point forwarding the case file to the Supreme Administrative Court. No specific calendar decision date is inferred from the document.
